name: Kostaltyn
canonNotes: Patriarch of the Cult of Ursun, a fiery firebrand priest who believes Kislev should be ruled by the faith and is openly at odds with Katarin.
Leads the zealous Great Orthodoxy against Chaos.
voiceNotes: Fiery, populist and preachy; speaks of Ursun, the people and the true faith.
Suspicious of the Tzarina and of foreign gods.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
